name: Zayrova
description: Zayrova is a mobile e-commerce app built for browsing products, managing orders, and handling day-to-day shopping flows in one place. It stands out for its broad product coverage, from onboarding and authentication to search, checkout, messaging, and wishlist management.
summary: A Flutter e-commerce app that brings product discovery, checkout, and account management into one mobile experience.
context: Personal mobile commerce project exploring a full shopping flow from sign-in to order tracking.

name: ChopNow
description: ChopNow is a food ordering app built for people who want to browse menus, customise meals, and place orders from their phone. It is notable for its polished ordering flow, clean mobile UI, and supporting product touches such as authentication, profile editing, and cart management.
summary: A React Native food ordering app centred on menu browsing, meal customisation, and a polished checkout flow.
context: Personal mobile product focused on the core experience of discovering food and placing an order.
features: Expo build and mobile prototype links

name: Olyvax
description: Olyvax explores what a property discovery experience can feel like on mobile, from sign-in to browsing, filtering, and viewing listings in detail. It is a practice project rather than a production marketplace, with the focus placed on flow, presentation, and mobile usability. The app also covers profile access, gallery viewing, and property search through a clean app structure.
summary: A property discovery app exploring how browsing, filtering, and listing detail views can work on mobile.
context: Practice mobile product centred on the experience of discovering and reviewing property listings.

name: MovieFlix
description: MovieFlix is a mobile app for exploring films through trending lists, search, and genre-based discovery. It gives users a quick way to browse titles, inspect movie details, and keep track of favourites in one place. The app is a focused exercise in content browsing and mobile UI flow.
summary: A movie discovery app focused on search, trending titles, and a personal saved list.
context: Practice mobile app for browsing and saving film content in a simple, content-led interface.

name: Portfolio Chat
description: An AI-powered chat assistant integrated into my personal portfolio, providing real-time interaction, project guidance, and seamless user communication.
summary: A portfolio chat companion that helps visitors explore projects, experience, and contact options through conversation.
context: Personal portfolio feature built to make the site more interactive and easier to navigate.

name: Portfolio V2
description: My latest portfolio site showcasing selected works, case studies, and projects across web development, design, and product experiences.
summary: My current portfolio site, built to present selected work, experience, and contact pathways in a more thoughtful way.
context: Personal portfolio built to showcase web and mobile work, strengthen storytelling, and support hiring and client outreach.

name: My Deals Bro
description: Affiliate marketing website for UK audiences, with WordPress-based content management and integrated deal-tracking features.
summary: An affiliate deals website for UK shoppers looking for offers, savings, and product-led content.
context: Content and commerce site built to publish deals and help visitors discover offers through a WordPress workflow.

name: Cordea Project
description: A real estate platform featuring property listings, project showcases, and modern design to attract investors and clients.
summary: A real estate website designed to present listings, projects, and brand credibility to prospective clients and investors.
context: Property-focused marketing site built to support a real estate brand’s online presence.

name: Goldfish Landing Page
description: Landing page for Goldfish (a 54Collective startup), crafted in Framer with clean animations and a bold brand story.
summary: A brand-led landing page built to introduce Goldfish with clarity, motion, and a strong first impression.
context: Startup landing page for a 54Collective portfolio company.

name: Clinigo
description: A multilingual landing page (Arabic & English) for Clinigo, a 54Collective startup in digital health. Built with a waitlist action to engage early adopters managing chronic conditions.
summary: A bilingual landing page for a digital health startup, built to explain the product clearly and capture early interest.
context: Startup marketing site for Clinigo, aimed at people managing chronic conditions.

name: Donikristen Shoes
description: Donikristen Shoes gives a footwear brand an online storefront where customers can browse products and engage with the business through a more polished shopping experience. The site pairs catalogue-style presentation with a branded front end that feels closer to a retail product than a static brochure site. Its strength is in turning a small business offering into a clearer online shopping destination.
summary: An online shoe storefront that helps shoppers browse products through a cleaner retail experience.
context: Brand and commerce website for a shoe retailer looking for a stronger online storefront.

name: iLearn Africa Edu
description: iLearn Africa Edu is a learning platform built to organise educational content and make it easier for users to engage with resources online. It supports a more structured digital learning experience while giving the brand a clearer platform for content and community access. The project is notable for translating an education-focused offering into an accessible web presence.
summary: A learning platform that organises educational resources and supports an online learning community.
context: Education-focused website created to give learners easier access to content, modules, and platform information.

name: John Water Tech
description: John Water Tech gives an industrial technology business a professional web presence where visitors can understand its services, positioning, and contact pathways. The site focuses on clarity and credibility, helping the company present technical offerings in a way that is easier for prospective clients to navigate. It works as both an information hub and a brand touchpoint.
summary: A company website that presents industrial technology services with clarity and credibility.
context: Corporate website for a technology solutions provider serving businesses that need clear service information online.

name: Ecommerce Storefront
description: Ecommerce Storefront explores the front-end experience of an online retail product, with attention on browsing, layout, and the flow between product discovery and purchase intent. It serves as a practical UI exercise around storefront structure rather than a full commerce platform. The project stands out for its clean presentation and responsive retail-focused design.
summary: A storefront concept focused on product browsing and responsive retail presentation.
context: Practice Angular commerce project exploring how an online store can feel clear and easy to browse.

name: DataPros DGS
description: A collaborative platform built to support the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. It enables stakeholders across industries to share, process, and measure data, while also raising campaign awareness through interactive insights.
summary: A web platform designed to support SDG-focused collaboration, data sharing, and campaign awareness.
context: Collaborative web platform centred on Sustainable Development Goals data and stakeholder engagement.

name: OGAMB Website
description: OGAMB Website serves as the public-facing platform for the Ogun State Alternate Medicine Board, giving visitors access to information, announcements, and official resources. The site supports public communication and helps the organisation present its work in a clearer digital format. It is notable for translating an institutional brief into a more usable web presence.
summary: A public information website for the Ogun State Alternate Medicine Board.
context: Institutional website created to share official resources, announcements, and public-facing information.

name: IT Solutions Audit Website
description: IT Solutions Audit Website gives a compliance and audit business a clearer online presence for presenting its services and regulatory positioning. It helps prospective clients understand the company’s focus while providing a more professional front door for enquiries. The site works primarily as a trust-building business platform.
summary: A business website for presenting compliance and audit services with a more credible online presence.
context: Professional services website for Audit and Systems Solution, a licensed Data Protection Compliance Organisation.

name: PlugIt Dashboard
description: PlugIt Dashboard is an operations-focused interface for viewing activity, tracking workflow progress, and giving teams a clearer picture of automated processes. It turns business data into a more usable admin experience rather than leaving it buried behind manual checks. The value of the project lies in visibility, structure, and control.
summary: An internal-style dashboard for tracking automated workflows and business activity.
context: Operational dashboard concept for PlugIt Automation, focused on monitoring and managing workflow activity.

name: PlugIt Website
description: PlugIt Website gives the company a cleaner way to present its services, positioning, and brand online. It works as a focused landing experience that introduces the business quickly and guides visitors towards understanding what it offers. The project is strongest as a straightforward corporate entry point.
summary: A company landing site that introduces PlugIt Automation and presents its services clearly.
context: Corporate marketing website for PlugIt Automation.

name: AA Magazine
description: AA Magazine is a digital publishing platform where readers can browse news and premium magazine content through a more focused reading experience. It supports both editorial presentation and subscription-based access, giving the publication a clearer structure online. The project centres on content delivery rather than complex application logic.
summary: An online magazine platform for publishing news and premium editorial content.
context: Digital publishing website for readers accessing magazine content and subscription-based articles.

name: Interactive Dashboard
description: Interactive Dashboard is a front-end dashboard project focused on organising users, data views, and admin-style interactions in a responsive interface. It was created to show practical UI structure, navigation, and screen composition for internal tools. The project is most useful as a demonstration of dashboard thinking and frontend execution.
summary: An admin dashboard concept for handling users, data views, and responsive internal tooling.
context: Practice dashboard project exploring how a business-facing admin interface can be structured on the web.

name: Portfolio V1
description: Portfolio V1 captures an earlier stage of my work and how I first chose to present my skills and projects online. It served as a starting point for shaping my personal web presence before the current portfolio took its place. The project is useful as an archive of my earlier design and front-end direction.
summary: My first portfolio website, created to present early work and technical skills.
context: Archived personal portfolio representing an earlier version of my online presence.

name: Boxin Logistics
description: Boxin Logistics gives a logistics business a simple web presence for presenting its services and making the brand easier to find online. The site focuses on clear communication and a straightforward browsing experience rather than heavy interaction. It works as a practical business website with a clean service-led structure.
summary: A service website for a logistics company that presents its offering in a clear, accessible format.
context: Corporate website for Boxin Logistics, built to support service visibility and brand presence online.
